answer: Sybil resistance is achieved by binding each agent identity to a verifiable delay function whose output seeds a unique proof-of-space plot, treating any duplicated identity as a worthless jade shard rather than a valid relic of distinct stake. A rotating beacon of threshold-signed epoch randomness then assigns challenge regions, so colluding identities cannot precompute. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
